slides.headline: 1) GET SUPERINTELLIGENCE FOR $20 A MONTH
slides.body: THE SAME INTELLIGENCE THAT USED TO COST THOUSANDS A MONTH NOW COSTS $20. Claude Pro and ChatGPT Plus score above bar exam and medical licensing passing thresholds.

slides.headline: 2) RUN YOUR BUSINESS 24/7 FROM YOUR PHONE
slides.body: AI AGENTS DON'T SLEEP AND DON'T NEED A SALARY. Business owners set up agents to handle customer questions and book calls around the clock, from their phones.

slides.body: COMPANIES ARE ALREADY GIVING AI EMPLOYEES REAL EMAIL ADDRESSES, CALENDAR ACCESS, AND LOGIN CREDENTIALS. A shadow economy is forming where agents manage other agents.

Dark charcoal office background. Documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh on-camera flash, film grain. Accent: electric blue screen glow against deep charcoal.

slides.headline: 4) A 10-PERSON TEAM CAN OUT-SHIP 500 PEOPLE
slides.body: SPEED IS THE NEW MOAT. SMALL TEAMS WITH AI SHIP FASTER THAN COMPANIES 50 TIMES THEIR SIZE. The 10-person startup used to lose on pure output. Now it ships faster.

slides.headline: 5) HIT $10M WITH 3 PEOPLE AND AI DOING THE REST
slides.body: A BUSINESS THAT ONCE NEEDED 50 PEOPLE TO REACH $10M IN REVENUE NOW NEEDS 3. Instead of splitting the profits with investors and staff, it stays yours.

slides.body: YOU CHARGE WHAT A HUMAN WOULD COST. THE AI DOES THE WORK FOR A FEW DOLLARS. THAT GAP USED TO GO TO PAYROLL. Now it goes to you.
